messages:
Ravi (partnerships): Heads up 10: we're running the CloudBridge marketplace launch tomorrow. Need a tight partner escalation path so support handoffs are clear. Who's owning the shared channel + warroom automation?

Maya (marketplace-pm): I can, but want a short, repeatable flow. Proposal: 1) shared channel `#pb-cloudbridge-support` for async comms, 2) auto-created warroom `#pb-warroom-<yyyyMMdd>-<seq>` for SEV1, 3) pinned 6-step triage checklist.

Leo (partner-ops): ok. For partner L2 inclusion we should use a shared webhook to invite their support account when warroom spins up. Also suggest a 10-minute silent escalation window before paging infra.

Tess (oncall-eng): For pages: SEV1 -> page `sre-oncall` + partner-ops, start bridge immediately. SEV2 -> only channel post + 15m check-in before escalate. SEV3 -> ticket. Keep it simple.

Ravi (partnerships): Good. Eli, can you draft the pinned triage checklist? Keep it checklist-style, <7 bullets.

Eli (partner-se): pasted checklist: 
```
1) Confirm customers impacted and business impact
2) Check running model version & recent deploys
3) Collect logs + sample input/outputs
4) Attempt quick mitigation (traffic-shed/rollback/route)
5) Notify partner L2 + note contact method
6) If no steady progress in 15m escalate to SRE lead
```

Maya (marketplace-pm): Nice. Leo, can DevBot auto-create the warroom and DM the bridge link?

DevBot: Warroom creation available. Example API call:
```
POST /api/warrooms {"partner":"cloudbridge","env":"prod","sev":"1"}
-> returns {"room":"#pb-warroom-20260412-01","bridge":"https://meet.red/bridges/xyZ"}
```

Leo (partner-ops): I'll wire that into our alertmanager. Alert rule: if alert.label.partner == "cloudbridge" && severity == "critical" -> call warroom API.

Tess (oncall-eng): Quick note: add a runbook section: who updates customers and who runs postmortem. My suggestion: partner-ops + marketplace PM co-own customer comms, SRE + partner SE co-own postmortem.

Priya (customer-success): Agree. Also add a dedicated template for customer comms (short status + ETA + next update). I'll paste a draft into the channel.

Ravi (partnerships): Owners & action items:
- Leo: webhook + alertmanager hook for warroom creation (owner: Leo)
- Eli: pin triage checklist and SEV definitions to `#pb-cloudbridge-support` (owner: Eli)
- Tess: update runbook with comms/postmortem owners (owner: Tess)
- Maya: validate partner L2 contacts and run the 10-min dry run 30m pre-launch (owner: Maya)
- Priya: paste customer comms template (owner: Priya)

Leo (partner-ops): I'll also add a one-click "Open Warroom" button in the shared channel so partner reps can trigger it manually.

Maya (marketplace-pm): Suggest adding an explicit escalation path when partner channel is unresponsive: after 10m escalate to `product-ops` lead, after 20m open SEV1 bridge.

Tess (oncall-eng): Also capture the fallback model for model-serving incidents: if primary model load > 80% latency for 5m -> auto-route to lighter quantized replica (if available). Noted in runbook.

DevBot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run in 30 minutes.

Ravi (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll create the channel and invite CloudBridge now. We'll keep this thread for any last-minute tweaks. :thumbsup:

Eli (partner-se): \ud83d\udc4d

Leo (partner-ops): \ud83d\udc4d

Maya (marketplace-pm): \ud83d\udc4d

Priya (customer-success): will monitor comms templates.

Tess (oncall-eng): Ready for dry-run.

Ravi (partnerships): Closing out 10: final links will be posted in the new shared channel once created.
